audience: marketing teams reporting on Emma audiences and email campaigns

useCases.title: Review audience groups and membership
useCases.text: See audience groups and their member counts, then inspect the members in a group. Follow additional pages when you need the complete group membership.

useCases.title: Compare email campaign results
useCases.text: Find recent mailings and review their delivered messages, opens, clicks and opt-outs alongside account-level response statistics.

useCases.title: Inspect link clicks and recipient activity
useCases.text: Review which links received clicks in a mailing and inspect recipient activity to understand how people interacted with the campaign.
